text:
sophia: Quick — I dropped the first draft of the product launch blog + webinar CTA into the doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-blog-draft-v1
ben: reading now, will inline comments. one note: benchmark numbers need a short methodology line; don't just show raw throughput without context.
lisa-marketing: love it so far. can we add a 1-line exec summary above the fold? and update CTA to 'Join our live demo — May 10' for the webinar.
max-growth: headline test idea: A) "Make inference predictable for your app" B) "Predictable inference for developers" — leaning toward A for clarity.
anya-design: hero recs: small Figma mock uploaded (file: /figma/launch-hero-v2). consider screenshot + small team photo. I'll attach export in doc.
sophia: added HubSpot routing snippet to the doc. current fields: utm_campaign=launch-blog-2026, utm_source=organic, form_id=1234-abc. can Sales/Growth confirm extra fields we need?
carlos-sales: confirm. add hidden fields: interest_level, prod_trial, account_tier. we'll need mapping for enterprise leads -> sales queue A.
ben: I'll reword the benchmark paragraph and include methodology: 'multi-region p50/p95 measured on Hosted API and Dedicated across 1M requests, see appendix.' ok?
kai-research: that's fine. note: Private deployment numbers are estimates (internal env) — please mark as "(estimated)".
sophia: locking plan: lock draft by EOD tomorrow. if 👍 by 3pm tomorrow we'll queue publish for Wed. @emily-ops is registration page live and mapped?
emily-ops: page is live but copy needs sync. I will add CTA and validate HubSpot mapping tonight.
sophia: added a quick code block for the HubSpot mapping in the doc:
``` 
hubspot_form_id: 1234-abc
hidden_fields: account_tier=standard, lead_source=launch-blog-2026
utm_fields: utm_campaign=launch-blog-2026, utm_medium=blog
```
ben: small ask — can we soften claim language on cost savings until we have Optimize evals? maybe rephrase to "reduces token cost by observed ranges in tests".
sophia: good call. I'll change the language to 'observed token cost reduction' and ping Research for a supporting note.
sophia: checklist in doc: headline / hero / bench note / hubspot mapping / webinar CTA. if no major edits by 3pm tomorrow i'll send to legal for quickpass. :rocket:
